art_direction: 圆角窗框内有花叶、阶梯和小圆日，几何与有机曲线相互穿插。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create a flat imaginary garden contained within a softly rounded arch window. Place three oversized leaves, a small circular sun, and two broad steps inside the arch, using overlapping shapes to imply depth without shadows. Combine aubergine, sage, pale butter, and muted coral. Let one leaf cross the window edge so the arrangement feels less rigid. Include small stem cutouts and asymmetric step widths as details. Keep the arch silhouette dominant at small size, and avoid any lettering, ornamental border, or realistic architectural rendering. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
